references.text: Repeats the counting of the tribe of Gad with the same number: 45,650 men when they are organized in the camp.
The second census of the tribe of Gad on the plains of Moab, showing the change in numbers over 40 years in the wilderness.
Gad's birth as a son of Jacob and Zilpah, which is the origin of the tribe of Gad.
The list of Gad's sons who went to Egypt, who are the ancestors of those counted in the wilderness.
Jacob's blessing over Gad, which prophesies about the tribe's future as warriors.
